## Community Curation

::: {.mxcw-curation-invitation}
We invite you to contribute to a living flora of the W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula! Please help us to improve the accuracy
of the data presented here by adding curatorial notes regarding the provenance, taxonomy, or georeferencing of
records.

<span class="saanich-callout">Click on any taxon in the checklist below</span> to add a curatorial note. You can
also choose a taxon from any other part of the atlas, through the speech bubble beside its name.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="mxcw-curation-form-holder" @id="curationForm"></div>
```
